description: Add the Notifee + React-Native-Firebase native dependencies, register their Expo config plugins, and bump the Android versionCode to 24. Pure scaffolding so the next FEATs can import notifee and @react-native-firebase/messaging and so a prebuild resolves. Depends on nothing; FEAT-002 and FEAT-003 build on it. Verified versions: @notifee/react-native autolinks + ships a built-in Expo plugin; @react-native-firebase/app provides the config plugin and must be registered for messaging to work.
steps: In c:\xampp\htdocs\static4a\.worktrees\notifee-rich-push\4astore-v2\mobile\package.json add to dependencies: "@notifee/react-native": "9.1.8", "@react-native-firebase/app": "22.4.0", "@react-native-firebase/messaging": "22.4.0". Keep expo-notifications (still used for permission prompts) and all existing deps.

From c:\xampp\htdocs\static4a\.worktrees\notifee-rich-push\4astore-v2\mobile run `npx expo install --check` (or inspect the Expo SDK 54 bundledNativeModules). If it prints a DIFFERENT exact version for @react-native-firebase/* or @notifee/react-native for SDK 54, use the exact version it prints instead, and record the final pinned versions in ../context.json (build_system or key_patterns) and in this file's findings.
Run `npm install` from the mobile dir to populate node_modules and the lockfile.

In c:\xampp\htdocs\static4a\.worktrees\notifee-rich-push\4astore-v2\mobile\app.config.ts add the string "@notifee/react-native" and the string "@react-native-firebase/app" to the plugins array (anywhere in the list; keep every existing plugin incl expo-notifications, withNotificationLargeIcon, withReleaseSigning).
In app.config.ts change `const VERSION_CODE = Number(process.env.STORE4A_VERSION_CODE || 23);` default 23 -> 24.

If `npx expo config --json` reports that @react-native-firebase/app needs google-services wiring, confirm android.googleServicesFile './google-services.json' is still present (it is, gated on hasGoogleServices) — no change expected.
acceptance_criteria: mobile/package.json lists @notifee/react-native, @react-native-firebase/app, @react-native-firebase/messaging at pinned exact versions.
app.config.ts plugins array includes '@notifee/react-native' and '@react-native-firebase/app', and VERSION_CODE default is 24.
`npx expo config --json` from the mobile dir resolves without plugin errors and shows android.versionCode = 24 and the notifee + firebase plugins applied.
`npm run typecheck` shows no NEW type errors beyond the known usesCleartextTraffic one.
verification: cd c:\xampp\htdocs\static4a\.worktrees\notifee-rich-push\4astore-v2\mobile ; npx expo config --json  (assert android.versionCode == 24 and notifee + @react-native-firebase/app plugins present)
cd c:\xampp\htdocs\static4a\.worktrees\notifee-rich-push\4astore-v2\mobile ; npm run typecheck  (ignore the single usesCleartextTraffic error; no other errors)
findings:
DONE. Final pinned dependency versions in mobile/package.json (exact, installed & verified in node_modules): @notifee/react-native 9.1.8, @react-native-firebase/app 22.4.0, @react-native-firebase/messaging 22.4.0. Expo SDK 54.0.37's bundledNativeModules.json does NOT list these packages (they are not Expo-managed modules, so `expo install --check` has no recommendation and does not override them) — the FEAT-001 pins stand as-is.

CORRECTION to the FEAT-001 premise: @notifee/react-native 9.1.8 does NOT ship an Expo config plugin — there is no app.plugin.js in the package, and its main (dist/index.js) is ESM and is NOT a config plugin. Listing '@notifee/react-native' in app.config.ts plugins made `expo config --json` fail hard with PluginError 'Unable to resolve a valid config plugin for @notifee/react-native'. Notifee installs via React Native autolinking only (confirmed by Invertase's official Notifee RN installation docs — no Android config-plugin step; the only community notifee-expo-plugins exist solely to add an iOS notification-service extension, which this Android-only Play target does not need). FIX: @notifee/react-native is kept as a dependency (autolinked) but is NOT added to the plugins array. FEAT-002/003 can still `import notifee` normally. Only '@react-native-firebase/app' was added to plugins (it DOES have app.plugin.js and wires google-services); @react-native-firebase/messaging also has an app.plugin.js but is pulled in transitively via @react-native-firebase/app + autolinking, so it is not separately listed.

app.config.ts: VERSION_CODE default 23 -> 24; android.googleServicesFile './google-services.json' unchanged (still gated on hasGoogleServices, present).

Drawable resource names (for FEAT-002/003 Notifee channels/notifications): large/colour 4A-logo icon = '@drawable/notification_large_icon' (copied from assets/images/notification-large-icon.png by plugins/withNotificationLargeIcon.js into res/drawable-xxhdpi at prebuild; also set as expo.modules.notifications.large_notification_icon manifest meta-data). Small monochrome status-bar icon = '@drawable/notification_icon' (generated by the expo-notifications plugin from assets/images/notification-icon.png, tint color #FF7A00). For Notifee, pass smallIcon: 'notification_icon' and largeIcon can reference the bundled drawable or the remote NOTIFICATION_LOGO_URL.

VERIFICATION (all from mobile dir, Windows/PowerShell, worktree): `npm install` OK (869 pkgs); `node_modules\expo\bin\cli config --json` exit 0 -> android.versionCode=24, plugins/pluginHistory includes @react-native-firebase/app, @notifee/react-native correctly absent from plugins; `npm run typecheck` exit 0 with ZERO errors (the known usesCleartextTraffic error did not surface in this run; no NEW errors regardless); `npm test` 39/39 pass. No prebuild run (per context: coder verifies config/compilation only, does not build the AAB). newArchEnabled left true (no new-arch prebuild incompatibility encountered at config-resolution stage).
